stories.title: Father and son arrive in Turkey, seven months after leaving Sydney on a Vespa – video
stories.summary:

They have now reached the city of Amasya in Turkey.

They expected to continue across Turkey through Cappadocia and Antalya before eventually reaching Trieste in northern Italy, completing a route of nearly 40,000 km. Gabrieli, who was born in Trieste and has lived in Australia for more than two decades,.

The latest fatality was a boy who was initially reported missing on Friday. Philippine Daily Inquirer: Death toll from effects of ‘habagat,’ storms climbs to 7.

The latest fatality was a minor who was initially reported missing on Friday after falling in a river.
